Resource Management: In collaboration with Portfolio Managers, Development leads, Client Directors, and Account Managers, maintain a forward-looking view of project demand, opportunity pipelines, resource supply, capability, and recruitment needs. Champion professional standards, knowledge sharing, lessons learned, innovation, and effective QA/QC, while supporting technical governance and consistent application of BMS, WIN, and DO processes. Supporting Divisional and Unit Leadership: Participate in divisional planning and operational reviews; monitor people, utilization, capability, and delivery performance; ensure compliance with corporate requirements, including safety, ethics, training, and timesheets; cascade business decisions effectively; and dedicate appropriate time to people leadership, operational oversight, capability planning, and continuous improvement. Be a visible technical lead that champions innovation and excellence as part of project delivery across the group Proactively resolve resource, capability, quality, and performance issues. Prioritize long-term capability, workforce planning, and succession over short-term firefighting. Work with Team Leads, technical specialists, project managers to develop them into future leaders. Balance technical excellence, delivery readiness, people leadership, operational performance, and business priorities. Engage proactively as a member of the Divisional Leadership Team and act as a trusted partner to Portfolio Managers, Resource Managers, and Division leadership. Demonstrated success managing business performance, project delivery, utilization, staffing, budgets, and operational growth. Strong technical and market understanding of tunnels and underground structures, bridges, civil structures, and geotechnical engineering. Experience delivering major transportation, transit, municipal, water, or other complex infrastructure programs through planning, design, procurement, construction, and commissioning. Strong understanding of design constructability, temporary and permanent works interfaces, technical assurance, project governance, risk management, quality systems, and commercial delivery. Experience with alternative delivery models, including design-build, progressive design-build, alliance, and public-private partnership environments, is an asset. Experience supporting business development, strategic pursuits, and key client relationships. Proven ability to recruit, mentor, develop, and retain high-performing technical and project teams. Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management skills. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across business units, regions, disciplines, clients, contractors, and delivery partners. An established network across water, wastewater, transit, transportation, and civil infrastructure sectors as it relates to contractors, owners and other consultants and the broader Canadian infrastructure market is highly preferred. Bring your expertise, curiosity, and drive to make a difference. If you are ready to join a collaborative consultancy where your perspective is valued, your growth is supported, and you are empowered to lead with integrity, we would love to hear from you. The comprehensive benefits and rewards package is designed to support your health, wellbeing, and professional growth. We balance flexibility with connection, so you and your manager can choose how to meet clients, team, and personal commitments. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they have the opportunity to contribute. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA). Mott MacDonald Canada Limited will provide accommodations to job applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodations, please notify us and we will work with you to meet your needs.
